title: Sharpen averaged cyclotomic gap from 8ell^2 to 3ell^2 (no new kappa)
body:
## Summary

Scoped written analytic proof with exact finite corroboration. A zero-mean extension of the sampled cyclotomic logarithm improves Chafik Boukhalfa's PR #1025 averaged-height bound and its sufficient uniform circle-gap exponent for every prime-power radix r>=3.

```diff
- sum_k log H_k <= phi(r) [4(log r)^2 + 8 log r + 2]
+ sum_k log H_k <= phi(r) [2(log r)^2 + 3 log r]

- d = 1 + 2ell + (r-1)phi(r) min(r,8ell^2)
+ d = 1 + 2ell + (r-1)phi(r) min(r,3ell^2)
```

Here ell=ceil(log2 r), logarithms in the height bound are natural, and |P_k(z)|>=2^-d for every primitive embedding and |z|=1. At r=4096 the sufficient exponent decreases from 9,661,317,145 to 3,622,993,945. These are analytic bound values, not executed word lengths.

The new proof sets the unused residue-zero logarithm to -log r, proves zero Fourier mean and strictly negative remaining coefficients, and obtains exact Fourier mass log r. It then uses the cited primitive-unit average and resultant/cofactor implication. No predecessor verifier is imported or replayed. The first verified improvement ended the investigation.

The result was produced by Nick Petalas. Credit Chafik Boukhalfa / #1025 for averaged heights and the precision framework, Ali Romman / #621 for the nonzero resultant and cofactor argument, Rohan Guliani / #846 and Charles Bethin / #764 for the retained solver/suffix lineage, and the classical logarithm and finite Fourier identities. Exact proof and notice provenance is pinned in SOURCES.json. No historical priority is claimed for the classical ingredients.

## Evidence

- Warning-strict normal and optimized commands, each about 0.16 seconds, produce identical generated package-hash-bound receipts.
- `PASS_ZERO_MEAN_CYCLOTOMIC_HEIGHT`: 4,560 exact polynomial kernel identities, 78 exact harmonic checks, three formal logarithmic Fourier fixtures, 235 integer budget cases, 179 strict budget improvements and eleven rejected controls.
- Registered package replay, metadata/source pins, committed bytes and source-history preflight pass. Only the six new package files are changed.
- Official six-file export and declared-input integrity pass. The exported verifier passes with a read-only package, Git absent from PATH, isolated optimized Python, and an identical receipt.
- AST compilation, function-size inspection and staged whitespace checks pass. The verifier's managed-allocation and bounded rejection-callback deviations are documented in README.md.

From the worktree root, reproduce with the exact local interpreter path:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/zero-mean-cyclotomic-height
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -B research/zero-mean-cyclotomic-height/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -O -B research/zero-mean-cyclotomic-height/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/zero-mean-cyclotomic-height --check-source-history
```

Other machines may substitute their CPython 3.12 path. Only the standard library is required.

## Limitations

The universal result is the written argument in PROOF.md. The finite checks corroborate its algebra and arithmetic; they do not prove every radix. The primitive-unit estimate and prime-power nonzero resultant are credited premises. No optimal diagonal choice or optimal constant 3 is claimed.

No actual inverse at the reduced precision, rounded preparation, common-label compiler, dirty restoration, physical tapes/hosting, complete transform, supplier admission, new kappa or complete multiplication theorem is supplied. No native suite, Lean build or selected cold replay was run. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed. The selected frontier remains unchanged.

## Open next questions

- Optimize the complete interval estimate over the unused zero-residue value, retaining its nonzero mean. Begin with the piecewise-linear Fourier mass; mass alone is insufficient.
- Execute one actual small prime-power inverse at reduced precision, retaining all coefficient-preparation, rounding and restoration costs. The analytic bound alone does not establish that execution.

Structured first steps and blockers are in TASK.json.

## Related open work

No open PR studying the averaged cyclotomic-height or uniform circle-gap quantity was found in the refreshed live searches. Merged #1025 is the direct predecessor; merged #1428 extends its older estimate to a separate composite-radix domain. Merged #5080 improves an independent inverse-envelope factor for a given circle gap and does not prove this height estimate. Its open follow-ups were not taken. Sparse local notes and unpublished work remain coverage limits.

Related-work refresh covered #5931 through #5940, the ten other open account PRs published since the [advance CLAIM](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19218984). None computes the same cyclotomic averaged-height or circle-gap quantity.

- #5934 determines Gaussian-rational tensor-annihilator coefficient denominators and primitive heights. It concerns a different polynomial family and coefficient quantity; this PR computes no shared numerical value. No extra mathematical computations were run to compare it.
